prompt: Write a recorded statement transcript (about 250 words) between an insurance adjuster (lines start with 'Q:') and the claimant (lines start with 'A:'). The claimant was the driver in a sideswipe while changing lanes in Houston, Texas, and has concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1121; do not mention it.)
text:
Q: Thank you for giving us your time today. This recorded statement concerns the collision you reported while changing lanes in Houston, Texas. Please state your full name for the record.

A: I'd rather just give the facts, if that's okay. I'm the driver of the blue sedan.

Q: That's fine. Can you describe where you were when the collision happened?

A: I was on the interstate, in the middle of the three lanes, heading toward downtown. Traffic had slowed a bit, so I checked my mirror and signaled to move into the right lane.

Q: Did you check your blind spot before you moved over?

A: I looked over my shoulder, yes. I didn't see anything right beside me, so I started to merge.

Q: What happened next?

A: A pickup truck came up on my right side and clipped the rear quarter panel of my car. It pushed me back toward the center lane and I had to correct hard.

Q: Did the other driver stop?

A: He pulled onto the shoulder ahead of me. We both got out and exchanged information.

Q: Did you feel any injury at the scene?

A: I had a headache right away and felt dizzy. The airbag didn't deploy, but my head hit the side window. I was confused for a little while after.

Q: Did you seek medical attention?

A: Yes, an ambulance took me to the emergency room. They diagnosed a concussion and told me to rest and avoid screens for a while.

Q: Are you still experiencing symptoms?

A: Some light sensitivity and trouble concentrating. My doctor has me off work for now.

Q: Thank you. Is there anything you'd like to add?

A: Only that I was following the signal rules and I'd like this handled quickly.

Q: Thank you. This concludes the statement.
